notes: Open-air stone/marble workshop ('שיש לנצח' monument maker) - a low single-storey structure that is mostly an exposed steel-frame with grey metal canopy roofing over machinery and stone slabs; steel frame not directly expressible so modelled as one floor with a flat metal roof and open front bays. Dominant street element is the tall coursed stone-block boundary wall carrying the banner sign, over a red-and-white kerbed sidewalk. Colours estimated 2026-07-04.
